description: Publishes privacy-minimized organization candidates and conditional provisional physical sites from Alaska DCCED's full active Business License and NAICS downloads.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects and accept only HTTPS requests to the exact Alaska DCCED BusinessLicenseDownload and NaicsDownload paths without query parameters.
retry: Retry HTTP 429, 5xx, and transient transport failures with bounded exponential backoff. Do not retry redirects, other 4xx responses, schema drift, orphan NAICS rows, duplicate license identities, observation-window drift, or quality-gate failures.
checkpoint: Each full CSV is streamed into a privacy-minimized immutable selected-field snapshot. Both source snapshots and their observation times are hashed before normalization. A complete unpublished staging run can be independently verified and resumed by immutable run ID; current.json changes only after publication.
idempotency: The coherent two-download observation window and SHA-256 values of both selected-field source artifacts identify a source release; the Alaska business license number creates a stable provisional organization candidate.
cancellation: Abort network and local processing cooperatively, close partition streams, retain unpublished run-scoped staging for diagnosis, and do not change current.json.
retention_profile: Retain immutable internal selected-field source snapshots and local-review-only normalized releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
